name: neural-weights-cjk
phase: NAME RESERVATION (0.0.1). The graph and vocabulary below are the v8-cjk-full 24k candidate (2026-09-05); the first functional release ships with the next mailwoman minor once the served board read is recorded (#2164 step 6) and the ja-jp / zh-cn overlays exist.

format.model: ONNX fp32 (opset 17), inputs char_ids int64 (batch, sequence, 7) + attention_mask int64 (batch, sequence), output logits (batch, sequence, 49). No SentencePiece tokenizer: the encoder is one unit per Unicode code point with a ±3 character window over the sealed vocabulary in char-vocab.json (2,335 entries, <pad> 0, <unk> 1, code-point order).

files_md5.$comment: The candidate artifacts' md5s — what a materialized package is verified against.

training.run: v8-cjk-full seed 42, 24,000 steps, batch 256, bf16, cosine, from scratch (corpus-python/src/mailwoman_train/configs/v8-cjk-full.yaml)
training.corpus: v8-cjk-2026-09-05 overlay: the v8-jp-full-2026-08-04 JP corpus (2,000,000 train rows, Overture-JP, four registers) plus 126 CN organizational-unit rows (cn-organizational-units recipe); source mixture overture-jp 0.98 / coarse-placer-cn-units 0.02

jp_board_20000.$comment: Held-out municipalities, coordinate-acceptability at 15 km via the municipality centroid table (corpus-python/scripts/score_jp_probe_board.py --label-set stage3-cjk). PyTorch read; the served TypeScript path reads 0.9633 with every tag within 0.2pp.
jp_board_20000.note: 598 of the 664 failed rows are one held-out hiragana municipality (かすみがうら市, 823 rows); the JP-only 49-label control fails 398 of them with no CN row in the mixture (#2165). Against the 47-label JP record (0.9928) the difference is that one name.

cn_board_14.$comment: The 14 held-out CN organizational-unit rows; span exact-match only, no coordinate truth.

model_lineage: 0.0.1: v8-cjk-full step-024000 (fp32 ONNX md5 e14ef4c426dabb22e9433ab04b584d48). Decision record: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-05-cjk-serving-path.md; receipts on #1176, #2034, #2164.
notes: One CJK package a consumer installs as a unit (#1177 Phase B): Japanese and Chinese ride one 49-label head; ja-jp and zh-cn data-only overlays follow.
Channel-free by contract (D5): no postcode-anchor, gazetteer, country or evidence channels; the graph declares only char_ids and attention_mask.

The locale hint routes a cjk character class to ja-JP; until the ja-jp overlay exists, load this package explicitly: NeuralAddressClassifier.loadFromWeights({ modelPath, charVocabPath, modelCardPath }).
